_comment: Labelled corpus for the semantic adjudicator. Every case names a file, its ground truth and why. The tool cmd/calibrate measures the adjudicator against this set. Add every real crack folder that gets triaged: the corpus is what turns the thresholds from a guess into a measurement. Paths are relative to the corpus root, or to the per-case 'root' when the file comes from somewhere else.
